deadline.value: The completed application deadline for Fall admission is December 1; the Spring deadline is July 1.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and are not used for funding decisions.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is optional

gre_subject.value: The catalog does not mention a Biology GRE Subject test.

toefl_min.value: The department page gives the old-scale TOEFL iBT 79, which predates the January 2026 change; the new-scale value is not confirmed.

ielts_min.value: The department also asks for an IELTS score of at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: at least 6.5 on the IELTS exam

supervisor.value: Before admission you must get a biology faculty member to agree to be your major professor.
supervisor.quote: Applicants for the PhD program must communicate with a member of the biology faculty prior to admission and receive agreement that the faculty member will serve as the major professor

funding.value: All newly admitted students are automatically considered for annual teaching assistantships with a stipend, tuition remission and health insurance, but awards are not promised to everyone.
funding.quote: All newly admitted students are automatically considered for this type of annual support, which includes a monthly stipend, tuition remission, and health insurance

entry_route.value: Students can enter with only a bachelor's degree, though a master's is traditional.
entry_route.quote: students may enter the program with only the baccalaureate degree

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog Biology PhD section. The department page at louisville.edu/programs/biology-phd gives the same December 1 deadline.
